This matches the javadoc stating that pre-defined tags are reference-equal (==) while unknown tags are only equals()-equal. To test the individual field-difference branches in equals(), I'll need to find pairs of actual pre-registered tags whose properties differ in just one field, since the private fields can't be set directly outside package-private setters.
